short.name: Retinal Scan Correlation
short.desc: Eye tracking data analysis to detect ESP/wallhack users by correlating gaze patterns with enemy positions behind walls

short.name: Physics Simulation Validator
short.desc: Server-side physics replay that detects impossible movement trajectories and collision bypasses

short.name: Binary Birthmarking
short.desc: Unique per-client code mutations that make each game binary identifiable — leaked cheats can be traced to the exact account that extracted them

short.name: Replay Sandbox Multi-Region Rollout
short.desc: Expands the Adversarial Replay Sandbox beyond its US-East pilot to EU-West and AP-Southeast — brings server-side verification to all regions

mid.name: Zero-Footprint Mode
mid.desc: Kernel module unloads completely between scan cycles — leaves zero memory residue, making Cerberus undetectable by cheat developers during reverse engineering

mid.name: Proof-of-Play Protocol
mid.desc: Cryptographic attestation that a game session was played legitimately — players can prove clean sessions to tournament organizers without revealing system state

mid.name: Peripheral Bus Sniffer
mid.desc: Monitors USB/HID bus traffic patterns to detect hardware cheat devices (Cronus, XIM, strikepack) by analyzing input timing jitter and polling anomalies

mid.name: Silent Honeypot Injection
mid.desc: Injects fake memory regions that appear to contain game state — any cheat reading them triggers instant detection without false positives, since no legitimate process accesses them

mid.name: Neural Style Transfer Detection
mid.desc: Detects AI-powered aimbots that mimic human aim patterns by analyzing micro-corrections and acceleration curves that neural networks cannot perfectly replicate

mid.name: Cheat Provider Lifecycle Tracker
mid.desc: Automated dark web monitoring that tracks cheat providers from release to takedown — predicts new bypass attempts before they ship based on provider development patterns

mid.name: UEFI Pre-Boot Attestation
mid.desc: Validates boot chain integrity via UEFI Secure Boot measurements and TPM PCR values — detects pre-OS cheat loaders, SPI flash persistence, and bootkit tampering before the game launches

mid.name: GPU Compute Abuse Detection
mid.desc: Monitors CUDA/OpenCL/DirectCompute dispatch queues for unauthorized compute shaders — detects cheats offloading aim calculations or ESP rendering to GPU compute pipelines

mid.name: Competitive Integrity Score
mid.desc: Public per-player trust score based on behavioral history that tournament organizers and matchmaking can use

long.name: Hardware Execution Tracing
long.desc: Uses Intel PT (Processor Trace) to record actual CPU instruction flow during game execution — detects code injection at the hardware level, impossible to spoof from software. Early research phase.

long.name: Federated Detection Mesh
long.desc: Cross-title threat intelligence sharing using differential privacy — multiple game studios contribute to a shared detection model without exposing any individual game's data. Exploring feasibility.

long.name: Autonomous Red Team Agent
long.desc: Reinforcement learning agent that continuously probes Cerberus detection boundaries — discovers evasion vectors before cheat developers do. Requires significant compute budget. Scoping phase.

long.name: External AI Inference Detection
long.desc: Detects neural network-assisted aiming where inference runs on separate hardware via DMA — combines DMA timing analysis with behavioral AI to identify ML-generated input patterns distinct from human aim

long.name: Firmware Forensic Toolkit
long.desc: Deep inspection of USB controller, NVMe, and PCIe endpoint firmware for cheat persistence — SPI flash integrity verification, UEFI variable analysis, and firmware CRC validation against known-good baselines

long.name: Inference-on-Edge via NPU
long.desc: Offload behavioral AI inference to dedicated NPU hardware for zero-impact scanning during gameplay — builds on internal NPU offloading research

completed.name: DMA Board Detection
completed.desc: PCIe device fingerprinting for DMA-based cheats — first AC to detect Screamer and custom DMA boards via firmware timing analysis

completed.name: Behavioral AI v3
completed.desc: 3rd iteration of the behavioral analysis model — TCN-based architecture trained on 8K labeled cheat samples from beta partners

completed.name: US-East + EU-West Deployment
completed.desc: Initial multi-region setup — 3 regions with sub-80ms signature sync latency

completed.name: Adversarial Replay Sandbox
completed.desc: Isolated replay environment that re-executes suspicious sessions server-side to confirm cheating without client intervention — eliminates false positives on edge cases

completed.name: Input Entropy Fingerprinting
completed.desc: Measures Shannon entropy of raw input streams to detect synthetic inputs — human input has natural entropy patterns that no cheat can replicate

completed.name: Cross-Session Behavioral Graph
completed.desc: Graph neural network that builds player identity from behavioral patterns across sessions — detects ban evaders even with new hardware and accounts

templatePool.name: Audio Fingerprint Scanner
templatePool.desc: Detects audio-based ESP tools by analyzing whether player reactions correlate with sound cues that should be inaudible at their position

templatePool.name: GPU Shader Integrity Monitor
templatePool.desc: Validates GPU shader programs at runtime to detect wallhack shaders and chams injected via graphics driver hooks

templatePool.name: Network Packet Entropy Analysis
templatePool.desc: Detects packet manipulation and lag switches by analyzing entropy patterns in outbound network traffic

templatePool.name: Social Graph Cheater Detection
templatePool.desc: Maps player social connections to identify boosting rings and organized cheating groups through behavioral clustering

templatePool.name: Memory Page Fault Canary
templatePool.desc: Places watchpoint-free memory canaries using page table manipulation — detects memory reads without any CPU overhead

templatePool.name: Polymorphic Driver Loader
templatePool.desc: Each client loads a uniquely obfuscated kernel driver variant — prevents universal bypass development

templatePool.name: Multi-Language SDK
templatePool.desc: SDK bindings for C#, Rust, Go, and Python alongside native C++

templatePool.name: Deployment Health Dashboard
templatePool.desc: Per-title deployment monitoring with SLA tracking and alerting

templatePool.name: Automated Regression Test Suite
templatePool.desc: Continuous compatibility testing across 200+ hardware configurations
